translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Shuwa pureimi.
Tsejtu bene Noénu Yavé tsandimi: Kumuinchi entsa tinbunu chumu chachiitala pensangue' keeñuya, ñuren main iya naaken chusa tyañuba tsanguen chumu juuve. Tsa' mitya ñu' bululaba baakusha bulu vide.
Tsenmin kumuinchi animaala Dioschiya ura kuramulanuya, llupu bain mandishpallu, supu bain mandishpallu ka' vinu juve, tsaaren Dioschi urajtu kuraa animaalanuya llupu bain main, supu bain main kakide.
Tsenmin vee vee pishkulanu bain supu mandishpallu kamin, naa llupu bain mandishpallu kaminguide, tsanguenmalaa yai bain entsa tusha piyai'mujchi chunudetsu,
matyu mandishpai malu insha 40 malu, 40 kepe shuwa jakaanu tsuyu, tsangue' entsa tunu kumuinchi in keñu chumulanu depirekenu tsuyu, timi.
Tsenñu Yavé naake mandangueñuba Noé kumuinchi juntsanguemi.
Tsejtu tunu debu'waakenu tinbunu Noé 600 añu juuwaami.
Tsenñu umaa Noé baakusha vimi, naa ya' shinbu bain, ya' nala bain, naa ya' suyala bain, tsejtaa pi bu'ñu yala livee inu.
Tsejtu naaju animaalaba, Dioschi ura kuramula bain, naa Dioschi urajtu kuramula bain, naa jekikemula bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimula bain,
pallu pallu Noéba baakusha bulu vila, llupu bain, supu bain, Dios naake mandangueñuba juntsaitu.
Tsenñu mandishpai malusha umaa tunu pi bu'dundami.
Noé 600 añu, ma chu'chaya, 17 malu juunu malunu, pi tainsharen tsaa tu deleetse'ke' pi defalekemi, naa kai'sha selusha bain pi deseetse'kike' jaimi.
Tsejtu tusha 40 malu, 40 kepe shuwa jami.
Tsenñu juntsai' shuwa janu malunun Noé bain, naa ya' shinbu bain, naa ya' nala Sem bain, Cam bain, Jafet bain, naa ya' suyala bain baakusha vila.

Tsenñu naaju animaala bain yaiba bulu vila, naa ajara animaa juula bain, naa cha' miyanuu animaa juula bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimu animaa juula bain, naa naaju pishkula bain, matyu tiba jekachi neimulaya kumuinchi vila.
Tsa' mitya naaju animaala bain Noéba pallu pallu baakusha vila,
matyu Noénu Dios naake uudengueñuba juntsaitu, vee vee animaala llupu bain, supu bain viila. Tsenñu bene Dios juukapa llu'mi.
Shuwa pure-i', 40 malu ja' dyami. Tsenñu pi bukenmalan, baaku tunu tsutun unguikemi.
Tsejtu piya kayu buke' lunchi ne iintsunmala baaku bain unguenchi ne kikentsumi.
Tsa' mitya pi tsamantsangue bukenchiren tusha aa katyu kuyi chumulanu bain tsaa debukikemi.
Tsejtu naa kuyila bain debukiketu, kayu 15 tyabulu jungue buke' dyami.
Juntsaiñaa tusha chumu chachilla millai peyala, naa pishkula bain, naa cha' miyanuu animaala bain, naa ajara animaala bain, naa ajkachi tunu shilla' neimu animaala bain millai peyala.
Matyu entsa tunu naajulaba ishin chumulaya depeyaila.
Juntsaiñu Noé, yaba bulu pumulaban laraimi, tsenmala mantsalaya, naa chachilla bain, naa cha' miyanuu animaala bain, naa pishkula bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimu animaala bain depeyaila,
matyu tunu 150 malu pi bukaa tsanañu' mitya.
